note: The fighters whose VFX casting (casting.json) is drawn with the Armory's effects (src/render/vfx/armory/castingSignature.ts). `live`: drawn in every build, release builds too. `fighters`: drawn besides in a build made with VITE_ARMORY=on (the Armory previews); a dev server reads ?armory=on (both lists) or ?armory=off (nobody, as before the Armory). `forge`: 'all' vendors every effect the catalogue clears besides (the Forge may give any of them to any fighter's slot, src/render/vfx/armory/forgeFx.ts). scripts/engine/armory/vendor.mts reads all three.
